name: HtAG Spatial
description: The htag-spatial MCP server exposes HtAG’s spatial intelligence layer as a compact set of authenticated tools for H3 cell analysis. It lets Claude inspect H3 cell geometry, move between H3 resolutions, translate between H3 cells and Australian geographies such as localities, LGAs, SA2s, SA3s, SA4s and GCCSAs, and retrieve grid-indexed market, price/rent/yield and socio-environmental indicators. This is designed for map-native workflows where users need localised property intelligence below suburb level, including heatmaps, catchment analysis, neighbourhood comparison, risk overlays and market signal detection.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HtAG Spatial to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HtAG Spatial to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.htagai.com/mcp/v1/servers/htag-spatial/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HtAG Spatial MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HtAG Spatial provides these MCP tools: get_h3_cell_info, get_h3_concordance, get_h3_market, get_h3_price_rent, get_h3_resolutions, and get_h3_socio_env.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HtAG Spatial?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HtAG Spatial in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does HtAG Spatial MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: HtAG Spatial requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HtAG Spatial is developed by HtAG Analytics. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
